# P31.13 (BREADTH.2): accountability breadth — CCOPS ×3 + FEMA HSGP

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.13__accountability-breadth-ccops-fema.md` (Round 9
Wave B, manifest row 154). Lands the **remaining 4 of the 8** `D-R7.3-BREADTH`
sources hosted — the row is verified **DONE (8/8)** — and records the
`D-SOURCES.12-1` engineering remainder: the 68 catalog probe-error rows
re-probed exactly once (**0 recovered** — 7 unreachable / 40 link_rotted /
21 non_target; nothing registered, nothing wired, rights unchanged).
Stacked on the P31.12 tip `devin/p31-12-accountability-breadth-federal-uk`
(PR #149).

The four sources were rights-flipped and LOADABLE since the P29.3 GL-GATE-07
batch but had no `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entry. The three CCOPS jurisdictions
now route through the existing `government_mandated_disclosure` connector
(jurisdiction index page → bounded document fan-out); `fema_hsgp_allocations`
routes through `procurement`'s USAspending family as a reviewed
federal-**assistance** slice (97.067 Homeland Security Grant Program).

## Summary

- **CCOPS index → document fan-out** (`government_mandated_disclosure.py`):
  each jurisdiction's reviewed `live_targets` row is an index page
  (Oakland PAC, Cambridge LegiFile, Somerville Legistar); the connector
  resolves only the jurisdiction-filtered document links
  (`/documents/pac/*.pdf`, `FileOpen.aspx`, `View.ashx`) bounded by
  `max_documents` (8/2/6) — never a crawl, never an unreviewed URL.
- **Reporting-period + multi-technology extraction:** `_reporting_period`
  recognizes `Date:` filing labels, anchor-derived years, and
  filename/report-title years; technology extraction supports `Surveillance
  Technology:` field values (incl. multi-valued fields), annual-report
  anchor text, and adapter-level `legal_authority_pattern`. Field-state
  claims keep the mandated-vs-populated distinction; every claim is a
  per-agency aggregate row (Part VIII — no person/plate output).
- **FEMA federal-assistance path** (`procurement.py`): the two reviewed
  `usaspending_award_search` page targets carry `award_kind="prime"` +
  `award_class="assistance"` — admitted by the `assert_pulls_subawards`
  contract and selecting the assistance normalization: `Awarding Sub
  Agency` preferred as `funder` (FEMA administers HSGP under DHS),
  `Recipient Name` as `recipient`; `instrument_type=federal_grant` §11.12
  `FundingInstrument` emitted only when award id + funder + recipient are
  all evidenced (the fixture's missing-recipient row proves suppression).
  Candidate identifiers ride every party claim — funding ≠ deployed,
  always (no deployment predicates exist on this path).
- **`runner.py`:** four `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` entries + fixture-run target
  selection for `fema_hsgp_allocations` so fixture/shadow runs preserve the
  reviewed `award_class` provenance (the `oversight_report` carve-out
  pattern).
- **Catalog retry** (`docs/build/tools/catalog_sweep.py` `retry`
  subcommand): the 68 `error` rows re-probed once into
  `docs/build/reports/catalog_sweep_2026-09-26_retry.json`. Zero recovered —
  an honest close: any future success would still register
  `ingestion_permitted=false` for HG-03 review.
- **Fixtures + cadence:** three committed CCOPS index excerpts +
  `SOURCES.md` provenance, the FEMA page-1 JSON; four monthly cadence
  rows (days 18–21 @ 06:09 UTC); four stale `live_dispositions` rows
  removed.
